recipes.name: EGGS PART II
instructions: For the Scotch Egg Method
Start by placing eggs into a steam basket and drop into a little bit of boiling water and cover. Steam no more than 6 minutes. - Eggs
Straight out of the steam basket plunge the eggs into an ice bath.
Once cooled after 15 minutes, crack each egg all over and place it back into the water for easier peeling.
Peel the eggs under running water. Place back into the ice bath and into the refrigerator until ready to cook.

Finely mince sage, thyme, and rosemary. Add into a bowl with ground pork. Hit with a heavy hand of kosher salt and a few pinches of freshly ground black pepper. Mix and mash the herbs and pork together. - 1 tbsp Fresh sage - 1 tbsp Fresh thyme - 1 tbsp Fresh rosemary - 1 ½ lb Ground pork - Salt - Black pepper
For the breading
Take a quarter of the sausage mixture and flatten out into a patty. Place the egg in the center of the patty and slowly stretch and wrap around the egg.

Once the sausage patty has fully covered the egg and patted together, cover the patty in flour followed by dunking in some beaten eggs and then finally cover with panko bread crumbs. Rinse and repeat with the rest. - Flour - Eggs - Panko bread crumbs
Heat the frying oil to 375°F before placing the eggs into the oil and frying for 7-10 minutes until an internal temperature reaches 175°F. Place on a paper towel laid plate and let cool.
For the mustard aioli
Into a cup or bowl mix equal parts mayonnaise and whole grain mustard. Mix until combined. - Mayo - whole grain mustard
Spread a pool of the aioli onto a plate and spread out using a spoon before placing the egg on top and serving.
For the Eggs Benedict Method
Start by cracking whole egg yolks into a blender with a sprinkle of paprika, a dollop of mustard, and lemon juice before blitzing together. - 3 Eggs - Paprika - 1 dollop Dijon mustard - 1 Lemon juice
After blending for 30 seconds, slowly pour in simmering unsalted melted butter. Pour into a pot once everything is thoroughly mixed. - 8 tbsp Unsalted butter
For the poached egg
Crack an egg into a fine-mesh strainer and swirl around a few times before placing it into a pot of barely simmering water. - Eggs

After about 3 minutes in 190°F water, remove the poached eggs and gently place on top of some fried Canadian bacon on a toasted English muffin then slowly pour the egg butter sauce over. - Canadian bacon or ham - English muffins
Sprinkle with some paprika before serving. - Paprika
